text:
ellie_cs: Weekly account health - flagging onboarding error burst for OrbitMetrics. High-level: overall error rate 3.9% (+0.8 w/w). Breakdown: 5xx ~50%, timeouts ~30%, rate_limit ~20%. Affects import + preview flows. Sharing top failing endpoints and quick asks.

zach_sre: Noted spike around 07:22 UTC from org acct-ORB-44. Short log summary:```
POST /v1/embeddings -> 640 rate_limited/429s (burst from bulk import)
POST /v1/batch-upload -> 280 timeouts (multipart job stalls)
POST /v1/generate -> 170 5xx (worker OOM / retry loop)
GET  /v1/preview-stream -> 90 timeouts (stalled SSEs)
POST /v1/auth/callback -> 25 5xx (idp latency)
```

mira_onboard: The onboarding guide defaults to 200-item batches for CSV imports; customers taking the promo hit that at scale. I'll update the guide to recommend 50-100 and add client-side chunking sample. Also we should add a visible warning in the dashboard about large batch sizes.

leo_support: Customer ticket CS-14500 from Orbit PM: they saw repeated 500s and want an explanation before the renewal meeting. Offered a monitored test window and one-time import assistance. They've paused imports. Renewal risk = MEDIUM-HIGH unless we can show improvement.

zach_sre: Quick mitigations I can deploy now: 1) temporary pool headroom for embeddings (acct-ORB-44) + raise per-customer concurrency; 2) enable early 429s for oversized batch requests to stop queue pile-up; 3) enable fallback to quantized model for requests >2500 tokens. Doing change now, ETA ~30m. Longer-term: proxy large jobs to async worker (enqueue + webhook) - ETA ~6h.

infra-bot: pool-adjustment applied by zach_sre at 1775002500 (change-id: pool-1145) :white_check_mark:

mira_onboard: I'll push quickstart edits and the KB about chunking/backoff. ETA 2h.

leo_support: I'll update the customer thread and offer the assistance session. Will ask if they want us to resume a small test import after the mitigations.

ellie_cs: Summary/action items: 1) SRE (zach) temp headroom + 429 rule + model-fallback (30m). 2) Onboard (mira) quickstart + KB (2h). 3) Support (leo) customer comms + monitored test. Marked renewal risk = MEDIUM-HIGH. Please confirm when error-rate <1% for 12h so CS can clear the flag. Thanks :pray:
